summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement, dated October 15, 2026, with Barclays and Cantor Fitzgerald as joint book-runners for an underwritten offering of 7,000,000 shares of 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock at $90 per share, upsized by 2,000,000 shares. Gross proceeds are estimated at roughly $630 million, settling October 20, 2026, under an effective Form S-3ASR shelf. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, including bitcoin purchases, income-generating assets, buybacks of Class A common or SATA preferred, and possible acquisitions. This is a routine preferred shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dividend coverage and dilution/overhang from the new perpetual series.
